snippet.title: WILL: Follow The Light - Gameplay Trailer | Galaxies Autumn 2025 Showcase
snippet.description:
Embark on a poignant journey in WILL: Follow The Light, a story-driven, first-person adventure puzzle game set in the unforgiving northern latitudes. Assume the role of Will, a lighthouse keeper on a remote island, whose solitary life is disrupted by a sudden disaster that strikes his hometown, leaving his son missing. Determined to reunite with his family, Will sets sail across treacherous northern seas aboard his yacht, Molly, navigating through perilous waters and exploring desolate islands.

As you traverse this harsh environment, uncover fragments of Will’s past and confront the emotional weight of his journey. The game delves into themes of family, loss, and self-discovery, offering a deeply immersive experience. With atmospheric visuals and a gripping narrative, WILL: Follow The Light promises to be a memorable adventure.

WILL: Follow The Light is developed and published by TomorrowHead Studio and is slated for release in 2025. Wishlist the game on Steam to stay updated on its progress and release details.
